rc_local.enable.description: Whether to enable execution of /etc/rc.local at boot. If false, the script exits early and no commands are run.

rc_local.commands.description: List of commands to run at the end of boot. Each entry defines a command with optional metadata.

command.description: The shell command to execute (must be a single line, fully qualified where needed).

description.description: A brief human-readable explanation of what the command does (shown as comment in config).

condition.description: Optional note about when or why the command should be present (e.g., 'only if GPU present').

ignore_failure.description: If true, the command’s exit status is ignored (using 'set +e' around it). Prevents rc-local.service from failing if this command errors.
